reactiveTwists is reported on /health: ON by default (PO ruling 2026-11-03), OFF for 0/false/off, and forced OFF by ORWELL_FLAGS_OFF=1

ON, cunning observer without a warm bond: EXPLOIT - a small, bounded, decaying tilt the nomination and vote providers read; it fades once the tell is gone
